datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly basis throughout 2019, classifying geographic areas of Uganda by acute food insecurity phase. The data represents medium-term projections of food insecurity conditions across different scenarios, with spatial boundaries and classification values aggregated by collection period.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular monthly schedule, providing geographic classifications of acute food insecurity phases across Uganda.
